card.name: End of a place or time phrase
card.fires_on: The last word or comma of a short place or time phrase (surgical suite, in the morning, at bedtime, in bed) right where a linking word like under, after or at would come next.

modes.label: Place or setting
modes.description: Ends a location phrase, often followed by a condition or further location.
modes.example: Administer OTARMENI in the surgical<< suite>> under general anesthesia with controlled aseptic

modes.label: Time of day
modes.description: Ends a time phrase such as morning or bedtime, before an 'after' clause.
modes.example: It’s best to check it in the<< morning>> after you’ve had a good night’s

modes.label: Comma or 'and' after a phrase
modes.description: A comma or 'and' that closes an opening phrase and leads into a qualifier.
modes.example: Dosage may subsequently be increased or decreased at appropriate intervals<< and>> according to individual response.

card.writes: It favors small position and relation words like under, across, within, near and at as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the end of a where or when phrase, where a word like 'under' or 'after' is likely to follow.
